name: 梦醒睁眼
framing: portrait, waist-up with complete hair silhouette and hands; centered front view
A: eyes gently closed, fingertips of both hands resting near her heart, tranquil sleeping expression
B: eyes opened brightly toward viewer, head tilts slightly, one hand has lifted beside her cheek in surprised awakening

name: 饼干眨眼
framing: portrait, waist-up with complete hair and visible hands; centered front view
A: holds a small cookie below her lips with one hand, both blue eyes open, curious teasing smile
B: winks one eye, cookie hand raised to the corner of her smile, other hand makes a small V beside her cheek

name: 纸页里的回眸
framing: portrait, waist-up, slight three-quarter turn; full hair silhouette
A: body turned gently toward viewer left, looking off to the side, fingers lightly holding one pink hair ribbon at chest height
B: same body orientation but turns face back toward viewer, raises a small open-palmed greeting beside shoulder, smile widens

name: 跃入梦境
framing: landscape diagonal foreshortened full-body, head near upper center, two shoes visible bottom right, entire silhouette with margins
A: floating diagonally toward the camera, knees bent, one hand held near shoulder preparing to reach, other arm opens sideways, delighted anticipation
B: extends the near hand toward viewer in strong but anatomically plausible perspective, open palm and exactly five fingers, bright laughing smile, hair flowing further outward

name: 穿越画框
framing: portrait full-body suspended in midair, complete hair, skirt and both shoes with margins
A: tucks both elbows and bends both knees close while ducking through an imaginary small portal, blue eyes looking ahead in concentration
B: unfurls both arms diagonally outward and extends one leg downward after emerging from the portal, joyful relieved smile

name: 纸剧场旋舞
framing: portrait full-body, upright stage dance, complete shoes and hair, centered
A: a graceful small curtsey holding the skirt edges lightly with both hands, knees softly bent, head slightly lowered and smiling
B: lifts chin and rises onto one toe, other knee bends outward, one arm curves above her head and other arm opens sideways in a cheerful dance turn

name: 触碰液态梦境
framing: portrait knees-up, slight three-quarter view, full hair and arms inside canvas
A: looks upward with wonder, one hand hovering near her eye and the other near her waist, relaxed open blue eyes
B: extends the near arm upward and forward with the index finger reaching as if touching a floating water surface, follows the fingertip with her gaze, astonished small open mouth

name: 水下舒展
framing: portrait diagonal full-body floating horizontally a little, complete hair, hands, skirt and both shoes
A: eyes closed, both arms gently folded near chest, knees loosely bent, weightless serene drifting pose
B: eyes open and arms slowly spread wide, one leg extends while the other knee remains bent, floating hair expands outward, soft delighted expression

name: 花朵的呼吸
framing: portrait waist-up, centered, full hair silhouette and hands
A: holds a single yellow daisy delicately near her nose with both hands, eyes closed as if smelling it, tiny contented smile
B: opens eyes and lowers the flower to chest level in one hand, other hand opens near lips as if blowing a kiss or petal toward viewer

name: 坠落的回声
framing: portrait diagonal full-body, complete silhouette with both shoes and flowing twin tails
A: falling backward with knees tucked and arms crossed protectively over chest, eyes squeezed gently closed, hair streams above
B: opens both arms and looks up over one shoulder, knees extend asymmetrically as she relaxes into the fall, surprised then happy expression

name: 故障中的笑脸
framing: portrait waist-up, close expressive face, all hair edges and hands inside canvas
A: both hands cup her cheeks, blue eyes wide, small bashful open mouth, rosy cheeks
B: laughing with one eye winked, one hand forms a V near the cheek while the other drops just below the chin, playful big smile

name: 折纸展开
framing: landscape three-quarter full-body midair dance, complete hair and shoes, centered broad silhouette
A: leans sideways in a small jumping twist, elbows tucked near ribs and hands close, one knee lifted, concentrated smile
B: opens both arms wide and turns shoulders toward viewer in a sweeping midair spin, skirt and long twin tails fan outward, delighted smile

name: 星际飞行
framing: landscape diagonal full-body flying toward upper left, full silhouette including shoes with comfortable margins
A: leans forward in a lively flight pose, one fist near shoulder ready to lead, both knees bent behind, excited eyes toward flight direction
B: extends that arm forward and slightly upward with open hand pointing the way, other arm trails sideways, one leg stretches back, determined joyful expression

name: 多重世界的下坠
framing: portrait diagonal full-body falling, complete hair and both shoes, centered consistent camera
A: falls diagonally with one arm forward and one arm trailing behind, legs together but gently bent, curious eyes looking downward
B: twists upper body toward viewer and reaches the trailing hand back upward, legs separate into a soft scissor silhouette, open surprised smile

name: 镜中回望
framing: portrait waist-up, slightly turned three-quarter pose, complete hair and hands
A: tilts head toward one shoulder, both eyes looking directly at viewer, one hand rests near collarbone, a quiet mysterious smile
B: turns head gently toward the other shoulder, raises one palm outward beside face as if touching the inside of an invisible picture frame, intimate soft smile

name: 牵住我的手
framing: landscape foreshortened knees-up leaning toward camera, complete hair and both hands, clear face
A: leans toward viewer with one hand held over her heart and the other near waist, warm expectant smile, open blue eyes
B: reaches the near hand invitingly toward the lens, palm angled upward as if asking viewer to take her hand, exactly five fingers, joyful reassuring smile

name: 快门里的鬼脸
framing: portrait waist-up, centered full hair and hands, front-facing
A: turns her face slightly sideways with hands softly framing cheeks, puffed cheeks in a playful mock sulk
B: looks straight at viewer and makes two small V signs beside cheeks, bright open-mouthed smile with one eye winked

name: 最后的圆舞
framing: portrait full-body upright floating dance, full hair and both shoes
A: arms spread in a graceful wide arc, one foot points down and the other knee bends, blue eyes open in joyful dance
B: brings both hands together in a heart gesture at chest height, leans gently to one side with knees closer, tender smiling face

name: 晚安克琪亚
framing: portrait waist-up, complete hair and hands, centered front-facing
A: both hands make a small heart at chest height, both eyes open, gentle grateful smile
B: one hand remains over her heart while the other opens in a small farewell wave beside her face, one eye winks and smile brightens
